name: WhatsApp bulk activity check
description: Registration status plus last-active time, active days and the Business flag, so you can tell live numbers from dormant ones across a whole list.

result_fields.name: identifier
result_fields.description: Submitted identifier, used to join the result to the input. Phone identifiers include their country code.

result_fields.name: activated
result_fields.description: The determined positive/negative signal for this product; interpret it in the product context.

result_fields.name: activedays
result_fields.description: Activity recency in days when available; not a precise last-seen timestamp or a guarantee of current online status.
